source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: When the client can create a structurally valid Attestation Credential, the existing execute request-header builder emits Attestation Capable Indicator=True. This is a derived test, not an official OASIS test case, and does not claim evidence generation or verification.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: When the indicator is omitted, preserve its absence and expose effective False. The existing 0006 test is retained and extended with an explicit effective-default assertion; derived, not official OASIS evidence.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Authentication may be absent when not needed. Model absence separately from a present Authentication value; derived test, not an official OASIS test case.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: If Authentication is present, it contains at least one Credential. Reject present-empty Authentication with a payload-free error; derived test, not an official OASIS test case.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: The server ensures that all supplied Credential structures are satisfied by its authentication process. This server-only duty remains excluded from client implementation and tests; the lowercase classification question remains KMIPKIT-DISC-041.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Authentication may contain repeated Credential structures. Preserve every credential in source order; derived test, not an official OASIS test case.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Represent Credential values that a client may use for identification. Authentication applicability remains profile-specific and is assigned to KMIPKIT-0010; this feature claims no profile support. Derived test, not official OASIS evidence.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: A typed Device value conservatively requires at least one of Device Serial Number, Network Identifier, Machine Identifier, or Media Identifier; §9.11 does not state that exact presence rule verbatim. Preserve all six Table 412 fields and impose no non-empty-text rule. Derived test, not official OASIS evidence.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: The caller supplies one or a combination of the four named Device identifiers that is actually unique. The source does not define comparison scope; KMIPKit does not verify uniqueness from client-local data. No client-side uniqueness test is claimed.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Represent optional Device Password without allowing it alone to satisfy the typed identifier-presence rule; derived test, not official OASIS evidence.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Require the Table 413 Attestation Type and Nonce members and require at least one of Attestation Measurement or Attestation Assertion under §9.11-006. Nonce ID and Nonce Value are separate required fields in §9.14/Table 419; their exact-byte preservation is traced separately as project policy.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Require and preserve the caller's Date Time Extended Timestamp. Cross-request monotonicity owner, comparison scope, and clock behavior remain unresolved under OD-003; no monotonicity enforcement or test is claimed.

source_document: KMIPKIT-SRC-spec: Key Management Interoperability Protocol Specification Version 2.1
statement: Expose SHA-256 as the effective Hashing Algorithm default when omitted while preserving field absence; do not calculate hashes. Derived test, not official OASIS evidence.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Represent absent Authentication and reject present-empty Authentication with no payload in diagnostics.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Preserve one or more repeatable ordered Credential values.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Provide typed views for all seven Credential Type values and preserve unknown raw enums and opaque values.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Validate known variant member types, requiredness, and canonical field order without interpreting unknown values.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Preserve six Device fields; require the conservative one-of-four identifier presence boundary for typed values; leave actual uniqueness to the caller and comparison scope unspecified.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Preserve required server-sourced Nonce and Attestation Type and require at least one evidence field.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Preserve caller-supplied hash bytes and Timestamp, expose effective SHA-256 when omitted, and do not calculate hashes or claim monotonicity behavior.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Emit Attestation Capable Indicator=True from the existing execute header builder based on the shipped typed capability, without Authentication or Credential payload.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Keep profile-specific authentication applicability and mechanism selection outside this feature and claim no profile support.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Redact secret-bearing values from diagnostics and zeroize initialized KMIPKit-owned secret bytes under the accepted ownership boundary.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Preserve unknown fields, enum values, and opaque extensions in generic TTLV.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Do not implement hashing, evidence generation or verification, Nonce generation, transport, retry, persistence, or a server.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Keep Authentication values standalone in memory; do not add request or batch selection/default/override behavior.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008
statement: Map every in-scope OASIS requirement to source, implementation, and executable test; trace project policies separately and list all exclusions.

source_document: KMIPKit Constitution and AGENTS.md
statement: Credential values remain in memory; no secret-bearing send path is added by this feature. Any future sender needs a separate approved feature and owner-through-transport lifecycle test.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008 and AGENTS.md
statement: Preserve unknown tags, enum values, bitmask bits, and extensions without assigning unknown standardized semantics.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008 and research.md
statement: Treat one-of-four identifier presence as a conservative typed-client interpretation, not verbatim source text. The caller guarantees actual uniqueness; comparison scope is unspecified. Preserve all six Table 412 fields.

source_document: KMIPKit Feature Specification KMIPKIT-0008 and AGENTS.md
statement: Preserve server-sourced Nonce ID and Nonce Value bytes exactly in the typed view. This project preservation policy is not attributed to a separate OASIS normative requirement ID.
